answers.why: Jezebel speaks of Ahab exercising kingship over Israel.
Ahab's descendants are to be cut off within Israel's kingdom.
Ahab has caused the nation Israel to sin.
Israel and Aram are kingdoms between which there has been no war.
All Israel are scattered like sheep and told to return each to his house.
Jehoshaphat begins reigning over the kingdom of Judah.
Ahaziah begins reigning over Israel from Samaria.
Israel is the kingdom over which Ahaziah reigns for two years.
Jeroboam caused the nation Israel to sin.
The LORD is called Israel's God in the account of Ahaziah's Baal worship.
Moab rebels against Israel's kingdom after Ahab's death.
Elijah asks whether there is no God in Israel's nation to consult.
The messengers repeat the question about God's presence in Israel's nation.
Elijah rebukes the king for seeking Ekron's god instead of consulting God in Israel.
